descriptor: Craft magazine of studio visits and interviews

voice.summary: Kiln & Reed Quarterly writes like a long afternoon in a studio: unhurried, observant and fond of the physical detail. Questions are open, answers are left to breathe, and craft is never made precious.
dos: Lead with a sensory detail, then the idea
Let the maker's own words carry the quote
Use plain, concrete nouns: clay, heat, glaze
donts: Do not summarise an answer that can be quoted
Do not rush to a conclusion

taglines: Every pot has a story behind it
boilerplate: Kiln & Reed Quarterly is an independent craft magazine that publishes long studio-visit interviews with potters, weavers and other makers.

microcopy.success: Quote copied. Credit the maker when you share it.
microcopy.error: The quote did not copy. Select it and try again.
microcopy.empty: No answers match. Turn off the highlights filter.

logo.note: A kiln flame names the craft at the centre of every interview.
